[[File:Grievous_gutsack.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous's]] synthskin gutsack]]
'''Synthskin''' was a medical technology very similar to [[Human/Legends|Human]] flesh. [[Synthdroid]]s, [[Human replica droid]]s, most [[Cyborg/Legends|prosthetic limbs]], and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] gutsacks were all covered in synthskin. It was very similar to [[Synthflesh/Legends|synthflesh]]. [[DD-11A]] was also covered in synthskin.
